rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Here al-ʿālamīn means all creation, in the description of the blessed land.
rows.anchor: باركنا فيها للعالمين يعني جميع العالم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-ʿālamīn can mean the generations after Noah, among whom Noah is remembered with good praise.
rows.anchor: سلام على نوح في العالمين يعني الثناء الحسن لنوح من بعده على العالمين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Here al-ʿālamīn means the People of the Book, who do not regard pilgrimage as obligatory for themselves.
rows.anchor: فان الله غني عن العالمين يعني من اهل الكتاب لانهم لا يرون الحج واجبا عليهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿAlā can mean that something belongs to or is inherent in someone: the Prophet possesses magnificent character; 39:22 is grouped with it.
rows.anchor: على بمعنى له قوله سبحانه في سورة ن وانك لعلى خلق عظيم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿAlā can mean an obligation incumbent on someone; the beneficent bear no sin or blame.
rows.anchor: على اي يلزمه قوله تعالى في سورة التوبة ما على المحسنين من سبيل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿAlā can mean from: the straight path comes from God.
rows.anchor: على بمعنى من قوله سبحانه في سورة النحل وعلى الله قصد السبيل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿAlā can mean by or through: believers are to trust in God.
rows.anchor: على اي به قوله سبحانه في سورة المائدة وعلى الله فتوكلوا ان كنتم مؤمنين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿAlā can introduce a condition: the marriage proposal is conditional on Moses working for the speaker for eight years.
rows.anchor: على بمعنى الشرط قوله سبحانه في سورة القصص اني اريد ان انكحك احدى ابنتي هاتين على ان تاجرني ثماني حجج

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Blindness may be blindness of the heart; Damghani groups this with verses about hearts failing to perceive guidance.
rows.anchor: العمى عن القلب قوله تعالى في سورة الحج فانها لا تعمى الابصار ولكن تعمى القلوب التي في الصدور

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-aʿmā can denote physical blindness, as in the description of the man who came to the Prophet.
rows.anchor: العمى عمى البصر قوله سبحانه في سورة عبس وتولى ان جاءه الاعمى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Blindness can mean lacking a proof: the resurrected person is blind to the argument for his punishment.
rows.anchor: العمى عن الحجة قوله تعالى في سورة طه ونحشره يوم القيامة اعمى يعني عن الحجة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿIndī can mean within my power, as in the reply about bringing the threatened punishment.
rows.anchor: عندي اي في قدرتي قوله سبحانه في سورة الانعام قل لو ان عندي ما تستعجلون به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿIndahu can mean in His heaven; the keys of the unseen are in His heaven.
rows.anchor: عنده اي في سمائه قوله تعالى في سورة الانعام وعنده مفاتح الغيب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿInda Allāh can mean from God's revelation and speech.
rows.anchor: الثالث عنده اي من وحيه وكلامه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿInda can mean by God's decree and power.
rows.anchor: عند اي قضاؤه قوله تعالى في سورة النساء قل كل من عند الله اي بقضائه وقدرته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿIndahum can mean in their hands, as in the question about possessing the Lord's treasuries.
rows.anchor: عندهم اي في ايديهم قوله تعالى في سورة ص ام عندهم خزائن ربك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿIndahu can mean does he know; the question asks whether he knows the unseen.
rows.anchor: اعنده اي العلم قوله سبحانه في سورة النجم اعنده علم الغيب اي ايعلم علم الغيب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿInda Allāh can refer to God's reward, which remains.
rows.anchor: عند الله اي ثواب الله قوله تعالى في سورة النحل وما عند الله باق يعني ثواب الله

rows.speaker: أبو مجاز
rows.claim: Abu Mujaz says the men on the heights are angels.
rows.anchor: قوله تعالى في سورة الأعراف " وعلى الأعراف رجال يعرفون كلا بسيماهم " قاله أبو مجاز

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Rijāl can refer to the vulnerable believers in Mecca.
rows.anchor: رجال يعني المستضعفين في الأرض بمكة قوله تعالى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Rijāl can refer to poor Muslims.
rows.anchor: رجال يعني فقراء المسلمين قوله تعالى في سورة ص

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Rijāl can mean human messengers, namely prophets who received revelation.
rows.anchor: رجال يعني الرسل قوله تعالى في سورة النحل والأنبياء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Rajm can mean killing; the threatened people say they will kill the messengers.
rows.anchor: الرجم يعني القتل قوله تعالى في سورة يس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Rajm can mean insulting or cursing someone verbally.
rows.anchor: الرجم الشتم قوله تعالى في سورة مريم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Rajm can mean throwing; the stars are projectiles cast at devils.
rows.anchor: الرجم يعني الرمي قوله سبحانه في سورة الملك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Rajm can mean conjecture, as in guessing about the number of the Companions of the Cave.
rows.anchor: الرجم شبه الظن كقوله تعالى في سورة الكهف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Rajīm means accursed.
rows.anchor: الرجيم الملعون قوله تعالى في سورة النحل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Rajāʾ can mean desire or hope: they desire God's mercy; 2:218 is grouped with this sense.
rows.anchor: الرجاء بمعنى الطمع قوله تعالى في سورة الإسراء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Rajāʾ can mean fear: hoping to meet the Lord means fearing resurrection; 29:5 and 25:21 are grouped likewise.
rows.anchor: الرجاء بمعنى الخشية قوله تعالى في سورة الكهف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The imperative arjih means detain him; the same usage occurs in 26:36.
rows.anchor: أرجه يعني احبسه قوله تعالى في سورة الأعراف والشعراء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The two boys for whom the wall was repaired were orphans living in the town.
rows.anchor: قال الله تعالى في سورة الكهف واما الجدار فكانا لغلامين يتيمين في المدينة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The promised forbearing boy is Isaac, son of Abraham.
rows.anchor: الغلام اسحق قوله تعالى في سورة الصافات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The boy found at the well is Joseph.
rows.anchor: الغلام يوسف قوله تعالى في سورة يوسف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The pure boy announced to Mary is Jesus son of Mary.
rows.anchor: الغلام عيسى بن مريم قوله تعالى في سورة مريم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ghilman can mean the young attendants serving in Paradise.
rows.anchor: الغلام الخادم في الجنة قوله سبحانه في سورة الطور

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The first sense of al-ghayb includes God, reckoning, the bridge, Paradise, and Hell as unseen realities affirmed by believers.
rows.anchor: الغيب الله عز وجل والحساب والصراط والجنة والنارقوله سبحانه في سورة البقرة الذين يؤمنون بالغيب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ghayābah means darkness, specifically the darkness of the well.
rows.anchor: الغيابة الظلمة قوله سبحانه في سورة يوسف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-ghayb can mean Solomon's death, which the jinn would have known had they known the unseen.
rows.anchor: الغيب موت سليمان عليه السلام قوله تعالى في سورة سبأ

rows.speaker: بعض المفسرين
rows.claim: Some commentators take the unseen here to mean the time of the Prophet's death.
rows.anchor: الغيب الموت قوله تعالى في سورة الأعراف لو كنت اعلم الغيب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-ghayb can mean rain and its storehouses.
rows.anchor: الغيب المطر قوله تعالى في سورة الانعام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another gloss for al-ghayb is the coming of the punishment people were demanding.
rows.anchor: ويقال الغيب نزول العذاب الذي كانوا يستعجلونه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the question about having looked into the unseen, al-ghayb means the Preserved Tablet.
rows.anchor: الغيب اللوح المحفوظ قوله تعالى في سورة مريم اطلع الغيب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-ghayb can refer to wives preserving themselves and their husbands' property in their husbands' absence.
rows.anchor: الغيب النفس والمال قوله سبحانه في سورة النساء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In this usage al-ghayb means the time when punishment will descend.
rows.anchor: الغيب نزول العذاب قوله سبحانه في سورة الجن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-ghayb can mean conjecture: they cast guesses from a distant place.
rows.anchor: الغيب الظن قوله تعالى في سورة سبأ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-ghayb can mean absence: Joseph says he did not betray his master in his absence.
rows.anchor: الغيب بمعنى الغيبة قوله تعالى في سورة يوسف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: An alternative reported gloss for al-ghayb in Joseph's statement is adultery.
rows.anchor: وقيل المراد به الزنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-ghayb can mean revelation: the Prophet is not withholding what is revealed to him.
rows.anchor: الغيب الوحي قوله تعالى في سورة التكوير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mafātīḥ can mean treasuries; Qarun's treasure stores were heavy for a strong band to carry.
rows.anchor: المفاتيح الخزائن قوله تعالى في سورة القصص

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mafātīḥ can also mean keys themselves.
rows.anchor: المفتاح بعينه قوله تعالى في سورة الانعام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fatḥ can mean a decree or judgment: the opening granted to Muhammad is a clear judgment.
rows.anchor: الفتح القضاء قوله تعالى في سورة الفتح انا فتحانا لك فتحا مبينا

words: ما يفتح الله للناس من رحمة
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fatḥ can mean sending or granting; God sends mercy; the same gloss is given for Gog and Magog and punishment.
rows.anchor: الفتح الارسال قوله سبحانه في سورة الملائكة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fatḥ can mean victory, as in the hypothetical victory from God; the author groups 5:52 and 61:13 with it.
rows.anchor: الفتح النصر قوله تعالى في سورة النساء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The entry begins its list of senses for fitnah by glossing it as associationism, but the excerpt cuts off before its example.
rows.anchor: الفتنة الشرك قوله تعالى في

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Atā can mean to do or commit; the people of Lot commit the objectionable act in their gathering.
rows.anchor: الإتيان العمل قوله عز وجل في سورة العنكبوت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Atā can mean acknowledge and submit: every creature comes to the Merciful acknowledging servitude.
rows.anchor: الإتيان الإقرار والطاعة قوله تعالى في سورة مريم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Atā can describe bringing a new creation after God makes the present people perish; the author cites a parallel in Abraham.
rows.anchor: الإتيان الحلق قوله تعالى في سورة الملائكة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Atā can mean literal arrival: Mary came to her people carrying the child.
rows.anchor: الإتيان المجيء بعينه قوله تعالى في سورة مريم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Atā can mean appear or emerge; Jesus foretells a messenger who will appear after him.
rows.anchor: الإتيان الظهور . قوله تعالى في سورة الصف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Atā can mean enter: people are told to enter houses through their doors.
rows.anchor: الإتيان الدخول قوله تعالى في سورة البقرة

words: ولقد أتوا على القرية التي أمطرت
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Atā can mean pass by; the author groups the passage by the idolatrous people and the ants' valley with this sense.
rows.anchor: الإتيان المضي قوله تعالى في سورة الفرقان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Atā can mean send: God sent Gabriel with the Quran, and the author groups the reminder sent to them with this usage.
rows.anchor: الإتيان الإرسال . قوله تعالى في سورة المؤمنون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Atā can mean arrive suddenly, as when punishment overtakes a town unexpectedly.
rows.anchor: الإتيان المفاجأة قوله تعالى في سورة الأعراف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Atā can mean descend: death comes down on the person from every direction.
rows.anchor: الإتيان النزول قوله تعالى في سورة إبراهيم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ithm can mean associationism; the rabbis and scholars are blamed for failing to forbid it and ill-gotten gain.
rows.anchor: الإثم يعني الشرك فذلك قوله تعالى في سورة المائدة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ahl can mean deserving or worthy: God deserves to be feared and is worthy to be asked for forgiveness.
rows.anchor: الأهل المستحق . قوله عز وجل في سورة المدثر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Aw can mean bal, 'rather'; the number is understood as one hundred thousand or rather more; 16:77 and 53:9 are grouped likewise.
rows.anchor: أو بمعنى بل . قوله تعالى في سورة الصافات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Aw can be additive, meaning 'and': Pharaoh may remember and fear; 80:3, 20:113, and 77:6 are grouped likewise.
rows.anchor: أو بمعنى ألف صلة . قوله تعالى في سورة طه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Aw can mark a choice between legal alternatives, as in feeding, clothing, or freeing a slave; 5:33 is grouped likewise.
rows.anchor: أو بمعنى الخيار . قوله تعالى في سورة المائدة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Āl can mean a people or community: Āl Pharaoh means Pharaoh's people.
rows.anchor: آل يعني به القوم قوله تعالى في سورة القمر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Āl can mean a household or family; the rescue of Lot's family in 15:59 and 51:34 is grouped likewise.
rows.anchor: آل يعني أهل البيت . قوله تعالى في سورة القمر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Āl can mean descendants and heirs, however remote; here the author identifies the line with Moses and Aaron and cites 3:34.
rows.anchor: آل بمعنى الذرية والورثة وان سفلوا . قوله تعالى في سورة آل عمران

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The entry begins listing awwal as the first to disbelieve and the first to believe; its other examples fall outside this excerpt.
rows.anchor: أول على أربعة أوجه أول من كفر . أول من آمن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Laʿn can mean metamorphosis; the author explains the curse on the Israelites as their transformation, comparing 4:47.
rows.anchor: اللعنة المسخ قوله تعالى في سورة المائدة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Laʿn can mean taking the poll tax; the author applies this gloss to their punishment and groups 4:52 with it.
rows.anchor: اللعن ضرب الجزية قوله سبحانه في سورة المائدة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Laʿnah can mean God's wrath; the author also cites the mutual imprecation in 24:7.
rows.anchor: اللعنة السخط قوله سبحانه في سورة البقرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Laʿn can mean punishment in the grave; the author says the Jews are tormented in their graves.
rows.anchor: اللعنة عذاب القبر قوله تعالى في سورة البقرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Laʿn can mean the prescribed legal punishment in this world, followed by punishment in the next.
rows.anchor: اللعن الحد قوله تعالى في سورة النور

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Laʿn can mean invoking harm on someone and expelling them; the author also gives the curse on wrongdoers in 7:44.
rows.anchor: اللعن هو الدعاء والطرد قوله تعالى في سورة الأعراف

words: عليهم لعنة الله والملائكة والناس أجمعين
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Laʿnah can mean the Fire, as indicated by the following statement that they remain there forever.
rows.anchor: اللعنة النار قوله تعالى في سورة البقرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Laʿnah can mean drowning in this world; the author points to two occurrences in Hud.
rows.anchor: اللعنة الغرق في الدنيا قوله تعالى في سورة هود مرتين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Laʿalla expresses hope here: Moses and Aaron hope Pharaoh may remember or fear.
rows.anchor: لعل بمعنى الرجاء قوله تعالى في سورة طه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Laʿalla can also mean 'as if'; the people build monuments as if they were to live forever.
rows.anchor: لعل بمعنى كأن قوله تعالى في سورة الشعراء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Laghw can mean an unintentional or mistaken oath that the speaker believes to be true; 5:89 is grouped likewise.
rows.anchor: اللغو اليمين الكاذبة قوله تعالى في سورة البقرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Laghw can mean false or idle speech; the command to drown out the Quran is explained as false talk and poetry.
rows.anchor: اللغو الباطل قوله تعالى في سورة المؤمنين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Laghw can mean swearing during wine drinking; in Paradise the drinkers do not swear as worldly drinkers do.
rows.anchor: اللغو يعني الحلف عند شرب الخمر في الجنة كفعل أهل الدنيا إذا شربوا الخمر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The cited complaint speaks of following guidance with the Prophet and is grouped with the wording about God's Messenger being sent with guidance.
rows.anchor: إن نتبع الهدى معك نتخطف من أرضنا كقوله تعالى في سورة التوبة والصف والفتح هو الذي أرسل رسوله بالهدى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Lā yahdī here means does not set right or make successful; the author glosses the plot as the work of adulterers.
rows.anchor: لا يهدي لا يصلح قوله سبحانه في سورة يوسف إن الله لا يهدي كيد الخائنين يعني لا يصلح عمل الزناة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hudā can mean inspiration: God inspired each creature how to obtain its livelihood and pasture; 87:3 is grouped with it.
rows.anchor: الهدى الإلهام قوله سبحانه في سورة طه الذي أعطى كل شيء خلقه ثم هدى يعني ثم ألهمه كيف يأتي معيشته ومرعاه

words: هل ينظرون إلا أن تأتيهم الملائكة
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hal can mean mā in the question about whether they await anything but the angels; examples in 2:210, 16:33, 43:66, 47:18, and 7:53 are grouped likewise.
rows.anchor: هل بمعنى ما قوله تعالى في سورة الأنعام هل ينظرون إلا أن تأتيهم الملائكة

words: هل أتى على الإنسان حين من الدهر
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hal can mean qad, 'indeed': a span of time did indeed come upon the human being; 88:1 and 51:24 are grouped likewise.
rows.anchor: هل يعني قد قوله تعالى في سورة الإنسان هل أتى على الإنسان حين من الدهر يعني قد أتى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hal can mean alā, an inviting 'shall I show you'; 34:7, 61:10, and 18:103 are grouped likewise.
rows.anchor: هل بمعنى ألا قوله سبحانه في سورة طه هل أدلك على شجرة الخلد يعني ألا أدلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hal can be a straightforward interrogative; examples are also given from 10:34, 7:53, 42:9, and 40:50.
rows.anchor: هل بمعنى الاستفهام قوله تعالى في سورة الروم هل لكم مما ملكت أيمانكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Halaka can mean die or perish; the author groups the brother's death, Jacob's son's wasting away, and a town's destruction with this sense.
rows.anchor: هلك يعني مات قوله تعالى في سورة النساء إن امرؤ هلك كقوله تعالى في سورة يوسف حتى تكون حرضا أو تكون من الهالكين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ḥaqq can mean a share or portion, as in the known share set aside from wealth; 51:19 is grouped with it.
rows.anchor: الحق الحظ قوله تعالى في سورة المعارج

words: ما لنا في بناتك من حق
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ḥaqq can mean need or desire; Lot's people say they have no interest in his daughters.
rows.anchor: الحق الحاجة قوله تعالى في سورة هود إخبارا عن قوم لوط

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ḥikmah can mean exhortation: the Quran's commands and prohibitions, including lawful and forbidden matters; 3:48 is grouped here.
rows.anchor: الحكمة بمعنى الموعظة قوله تعالى في سورة البقرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ḥukm can mean understanding and knowledge, as granted to John while still a child.
rows.anchor: الحكم يعني الفهم والعلم قوله تعالى في سورة مريم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ḥikmah can mean prophethood; Abraham's family received prophethood along with the Psalms.
rows.anchor: الحكمة يعني النبوة قوله تعالى في سورة النساء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ḥikmah can mean interpretation of the Quran.
rows.anchor: الحكمة يعني تفسير القرآن قوله تعالى في سورة البقرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ḥikmah can also mean the Quran itself.
rows.anchor: الحكمة القرآن قوله تعالى في سورة النحل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Yaḥillu can mean become obligatory or fall due: God's anger becomes due upon those who transgress.
rows.anchor: يحل بمعنى يجب قوله تعالى في سورة طه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Aḥlil can mean loosen or untie, as in Moses' prayer to loosen the knot in his tongue.
rows.anchor: احلل يقول أبسط قوله تعالى في سورة طه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Yaḥillu can mean descend or settle; the same gloss is given for 35:35 and 14:28.
rows.anchor: يحل ينزل قوله تعالى في سورة الرعد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ḥalaltum can mean leaving the sacred precinct for the unrestricted territory, after which hunting is permitted.
rows.anchor: حللتم يقول خرجتم من الحرم إلى الحل قوله سبحانه في سورة المائدة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Yaḥillu can mean make lawful or permit; the author gives the same gloss for 7:157.
rows.anchor: يحل يعني يرخص وهو من حل يحل حلا قوله تعالى في سورة المائدة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Zawāl can mean falling away from a place: God holds the heavens and earth lest they fall from their places.
rows.anchor: الزوال هو السقوط عن المكان قوله تعالى في سورة فاطر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Zawāl can mean cessation from worldly life; the people deny that they will depart from the world or be resurrected.
rows.anchor: الزوال الانقطاع قوله تعالى في سورة إبراهيم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Zāla can mean collapse: the mountains would fall from the enormity of the plot.
rows.anchor: زال بمعنى خر قوله تعالى في سورة إبراهيم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ziyādah can mean an increase of the same kind; the author groups increased guidance in 19:76 with this sense.
rows.anchor: الزيادة على الشيء من جنسه قوله تعالى في سورة هود

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The 'increase' promised to those who do good means seeing God; 50:35 is grouped with this gloss.
rows.anchor: الزيادة النظر إلى الله سبحانه قوله تعالى في سورة يونس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Zaygh can mean inclination; the author groups 9:117 with the heart inclining away.
rows.anchor: الزيغ الميل قوله سبحانه في سورة آل عمران

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Zaygh can mean misguidance: when they turned away, God led their hearts astray.
rows.anchor: الزيغ الضلال قوله تعالى في سورة الصف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Zayyana can mean make beautiful; the author groups its use in 6:108 and 3:14 with this gloss.
rows.anchor: الزينة الحسن قوله تعالى في سورة البقرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Zīnah can mean jewelry or ornaments, here the ornaments of Pharaoh's people.
rows.anchor: الزينة الحلي قوله تعالى في سورة طه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Zīnah can mean the bloom or flower of worldly life; 18:46 and 28:60 are grouped with this gloss.
rows.anchor: الزينة الزهرة قوله تعالى في سورة يونس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Zīnah can mean an impressive display or retinue: Qarun went out with servants, women, and horses; 16:8 is grouped with it.
rows.anchor: الزينة المنظر الحسن قوله تعالى
